'''Staghelm Point''' {{coords|70|26|Silithus}} is a tower on the top of a peak in northeastern [[Silithus]] {{co|70|25|Silithus}}. It is either named for Archdruid [[Fandral Staghelm]], who led the night elf armies in the [[War of the Shifting Sands]], or for his son [[Valstann Staghelm]], who fell during that war.

[[Ralo'shan the Eternal Watcher]] resides here, and a bronze drake from the [[Brood of Nozdormu]] circles the skies above the tower.
